title: Measurement comparison schema
responsibility: Defines the protocol, units and complete context required to compare benchmark measurements.

outputs.name: roundsProtocol
outputs.description: Protocol id harness-rounds/1 for warmed rounds of complete invocations.

outputs.name: warmupCalls
outputs.description: Three calls made before timed benchmark rounds.

outputs.name: measurementBoundaries
outputs.description: Allowed boundaries: public-invocation for the whole runtime call, or fixture for a declared test value.

outputs.name: metricUnits
outputs.description: Expected units: milliseconds for cold, warm and floor latency; ops/s for throughput; bytes for memory.

outputs.name: comparisonSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod schema for a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 request digest, supported boundary, nonempty trimmed protocol and strict sampling counts with nonnegative warm-up and positive rounds and iterations.
